footnote_text: These securities are solely owned by Rice Family Foundation who may be deemed to be a member of a "group" with Series R of UM Partners, LLC, Series U of UM Partners, LLC, Dylan Lissette and Timothy Brown for purposes of Section 13(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"). || Pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement"), dated as of July 20, 2026, by and among the Issuer, Idaho USA, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Acquiror"), Idaho Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and direct or indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Acquiror ("Merger Sub"), and Intersnack Group GmbH & Co. KG, a German limited partnership (Kommanditgesellschaft) ("Parent"), on November 20, 2026, Merger Sub merged with and into the Issuer (the "Merger"), with the Issuer surviving and becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. As a result of the Merger, the Class A Common Stock was delisted from the New York Stock Exchange and will be deregistered under the Exchange Act. || At the effective time of the Merger, and pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, each share of Class A Common Stock held by the Reporting Person was automatically converted into the right to receive $14.25 per share, in cash, without interest.
